description: The Sound role's profile for a product walkthrough: a steady, mid-tempo bed with no drop, and the product's own sounds on top: a click per press, a keystroke per typed character, a tick per checked row, one chime when the result lands, a soft whoosh per camera move. The effects are the point; the music keeps them company.

tempo.walkthrough: 18 to 30 s at 105 to 115 BPM: a beat is about 0.55 s, the pace a pointer travels between two targets in 2 beats
tempo.calmer: 30 to 45 s at 90 to 100 BPM when the screen has long forms to type; type slower (cps 10 to 12) rather than lengthening the film

structure: sound on frame 0 at body level (no silent cold open), a flat arc with no drop, the picture's events carry the energy; the music ends with a short fade (0.4 s) as the end card settles, never a long tail
fit: beats.py <track> --bpm <intended> --start <s> --window <s> --drop-beat 0: the fitted tempo, the downbeat offset, and the music.start that puts a downbeat on film beat 0; pick the stretch whose bars stay within 2 dB of each other

recorded.title: Focus on Yourself
recorded.measured: 114.0 BPM, grid strength 0.96 on the stretch from 19 s, drift 0 ms/min; from 20.927 s (a downbeat, +2.8 dB over what came before) the bars stay within 1.6 dB of -17 for 19 s, almost no energy above 4 kHz (no hi-hat clutter over the keystrokes); start 20.927 puts that downbeat on beat 0

music.generated: Optional. Higgsfield MCP generate_audio when its catalog lists a music model (models_explore type audio): get_cost first, show the price, wait for a yes, then one run. Its prompt takes a tempo as words, not a number field, so the tempo is a claim: fit it with beats.py and trust the fit, never the prompt.

key.note: Hard single key press in a laptop: a typed character

key_alt.note: Single key press in a laptop: a typed character, the other recording (quiet at the source; normalised like the rest)

key_soft.note: The hard key, 4 dB down: spreads the typing's level

tick.note: Modern technology select: a row checked

pop.note: Dry pop up notification alert: a list or a card appearing

chime.note: Confirmation tone: the result landing, the toast

whoosh.note: Fast swipe zoom: a camera move, placed so its peak is mid-move

page.note: Arrow whoosh: the page changing under a tab

levels.sfx: each effect is normalised to -1 dBFS before its gain, so a gain says where it sits against the others

gate: earshot critique on the encoded file; fix every [critical] and [major], or write down why a line stays
